name: discover-accounts-fintech-icp
description: Fintech ICP should return real fintech/adjacent companies, not generic SaaS names.

businessContext.overview: Real-time fraud + KYC infrastructure for fintechs.

icp.title: Head of Trust & Safety at scaling fintechs
icp.description: Growth-stage fintechs handling >$500M/year in transactions who face rising fraud losses.
buyingSignals: Recent fraud incident or public breach
New market expansion (US to EU or LATAM)

expectations.rubric: The returned accounts must be REAL fintech / payments / neobank / trust-and-safety-focused financial companies — verifiable via a quick search. Well-known names (Chime, Wise, Nubank, Revolut, Mercury, Ramp, Brex, Airwallex, Klarna) are a plus but not required. Less-famous companies (Zero Hash, Alloy, Persona, Sardine, Unit, Column, Rain, Rho) also score high AS LONG AS they are real fintech companies plausibly in the ICP. Score low if the list is dominated by generic SaaS companies (Salesforce, HubSpot) or clearly invented names that don't come up in a search.
